source.check: Votes as printed; 497-468=29. The paragraph states 'Unionists yesterday captured the seat'.

note: Triennial election of Fermanagh County Council, polled Thursday 2 June 1955 (Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1955: polling 'to-day'; Irish News, 3 June 1955: 'yesterday'). The only county council contest was Newtownbutler, where the Unionists took the seat; the Fermanagh Herald of 4 June 1955 prints the full nomination list, one candidate in each of the other nineteen divisions, so all twenty members are recorded. Structure and division names for the 1966-67 amalgamation are in notes/fermanagh-fcra-1969.md, from Fermanagh CRA, 'Fermanagh Facts' (1969). That is an advocacy pamphlet: use it for names only, not figures. Its register figures are disputed by Kingsley (2021) on the Omagh Rural District scheme. Read the page image before recording any number from it. No party labels are printed against the names in this result; the report identifies Gray as the Unionist winner and Carron as the outgoing member.
